title: Social Image Size Guide
description: Every platform's recommended image sizes in one place — pick a network and placement, see exact pixels and a scaled preview.
howto: Choose a platform (Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest).
Pick a placement — post, story, profile, cover, thumbnail.
Read the exact pixel size and aspect ratio; the preview box shows its true proportions.

faqs.q: Where do these sizes come from?
faqs.a: They are the platforms' published recommended dimensions as of 2026. Networks occasionally tweak specs — when in doubt, upload larger and let the platform crop.

faqs.q: What if my image is a different size?
faqs.a: Platforms resize and center-crop to fit. Matching the recommended size avoids awkward auto-crops and keeps text sharp.

faqs.q: Why does aspect ratio matter more than pixels?
faqs.a: Feeds crop to a fixed ratio (e.g. 4:5 on Instagram). The preview box renders each size at its true aspect ratio so you can see the crop shape.
